name: FX rates / legal-entity dispatch on non-core currencies
expected: CurrencyType.ConversionRate maintained per Confluence ARR table for every authorized currency (ARS 666.6667, CHF 0.8850, ILS 3.6251, JPY 149.2537, etc.); reports/dashboards/DocGen consolidate foreign->USD at true rates and render via CurrencyType.DecimalPlaces (JPY=0); correct legal entity drives currency/Workday ref (Japan -> Fortra Japan KK JPY COM071). Pricing proc is decoupled and unaffected.
actual: CurrencyType.ConversionRate corrupted: 6 of 11 non-USD currencies sit at PLACEHOLDER 1.0 -- ARS=1.0 (auth 666.6667), CHF=1.0 (0.8850), GBP=1.0 (0.7874), ILS=1.0 (3.6251), JPY=1.0 (149.2537), NZD=1.0 (1.6667). DatedConversionRate (Advanced Currency Mgmt ON) shows ARS reset 1428.5714 -> 1.0 on 2026-02-11/-12/-13, so any foreign txn dated >= 2026-02-11 consolidates at face value (JPY shown 1:1 with USD). The 4 currencies test_setup named (ARS/CHF/ILS/JPY) are ALL at 1.0. JPY DecimalPlaces=0 is CORRECT. AUD 1.52 / CAD 1.35 / EUR 0.92 also DRIFT from authoritative 1.5385/1.3889/0.9346 (FX-derived placeholders). MXN/SEK are active orphans not in the Confluence doc (12 active currencies vs 5-in-scope / 10-doc). Pricing proc V21 is NOT affected: it reads Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt which holds the CORRECT authoritative rates (EUR 0.9346 etc.) -- proven by G-01 PASS (EUR 500 -> 467.3 = x0.9346, not x0.92). Legal-entity backbone is correctly configured (Fortra Japan KK = COM071 = JPY = primary mapping) and 90% populated on Orders.
evidence: Data/sc3384/g08_evidence/G08_currencytype_evidence.txt ; CurrencyType query (ARS/CHF/GBP/ILS/JPY/NZD ConversionRate=1.0; JPY DecimalPlaces=0); DatedConversionRate ARS 1428.5714->1.0 @2026-02-11; Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt JPY=149.2537/EUR=0.9346 (proc source, correct); LegalEntity Fortra Japan KK 0fwWC0000000CNlYAM Workday_Reference_ID__c=COM071 CurrencyIsoCode=JPY Active; Legal_Entity_Currency__mdt Fortra_Japan_JPY Is_Primary=true
proposedFix: Reload CurrencyType.ConversionRate (and forward-dated DatedConversionRate entries) for ARS/CHF/GBP/ILS/JPY/NZD from the authoritative Dec-2024 Confluence ARR table (ARS 666.6667, CHF 0.8850, GBP 0.7874, ILS 3.6251, JPY 149.2537, NZD 1.6667), realigning AUD/CAD/EUR to 1.5385/1.3889/0.9346; deactivate orphan MXN/SEK or add them to the doc; identify and stop the automation that reset rates to 1.0 on 2026-02-11/-12/-13. No pricing-procedure change needed (proc reads the correct Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt). Described, NOT applied (validation only, no deploy/DML).
notes: Config/parity scenario -> validated by querying org config + proc metadata, no DML fixture (per brief). Root-cause SPLIT: (1) reportable ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT = CurrencyType.ConversionRate placeholder 1.0 on 6 currencies feeding reports/dashboards/DocGen/downstream invoicing -- exactly the surface the scenario tests, matches SC-3384 org-wide-reach finding (129 reports + 20 dashboards consolidate at face value). (2) Pricing proc V21 is CLEAN -- decoupled via Currency_Conversion_Formula__mdt; the V21 currency-conversion steps (33-36) are correct (confirmed by G-01 PASS). (3) JPY DecimalPlaces=0 correct; render bug (DMTransformFortraQuote hardcodes ROUND(x,2)) is downstream-template, out of CurrencyType config scope. (4) Scenario text said Place.Default_Legal_Entity__c but the field lives on ACCOUNT (Places__c has no legal-entity lookup) -- minor EXPECTATION-ERROR in the scenario text, not the verdict driver; dispatch backbone EXISTS and is correctly mapped (Fortra Japan KK=COM071=JPY=primary). 65 migrated JPY orders mis-point to 'DO NOT USE - Inactive' LEs, but those are bulk-loaded test data (all created 2026-05-08, LE stamped by migration not the live dispatch automation) -> TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT, not provable as a live engine defect. Preflight pass: CurrencyType is real org config (single row per ISO, no shadow copy), authoritative rates pinned from Confluence ARR table per memory project_sc3384_multicurrency_pricing. defect_provenance SC-3384 (multicurrency) confirmed; SC-3298/BUG-MTC-388 (Place required fields) is a separate Order-Place address concern not exercised here.
verdict_reason: Org config IS defective in exactly the way test_setup named -- CurrencyType.ConversionRate for ARS/CHF/ILS/JPY (and GBP/NZD) is the placeholder 1.0 not the authoritative rate, so reports/DocGen/invoicing consolidate foreign currencies at face value; this is a reportable ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT (SC-3384), while the pricing procedure V21 itself is correctly decoupled and unaffected.
